question.problem: Suppose we are applying the elementary row operation ${R}_{1}:={R}_{1}+4{R}_{2}$ to a $2\times 2$ matrix $A.$ Find the equivalent notation in terms of matrix multiplication.
question.worked_solution:
We need to find an elementary matrix $E$ such that $EA$ is equivalent to applying the elementary row operation ${R}_{1}:={R}_{1}+4{R}_{2}$ to $A.$

To find $E,$ we apply the given row operation to the identity matrix as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}I & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & :={R}_{1}+4{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 4 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}] \\  & =E\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the equivalent notation in terms of matrix multiplication is $EA:$

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & 4 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}]\cdot A
$$
